# Miscellania and Etceteria

The two islands of areas/area_miscellania. Reached by the longship from Rellekka once The Fremennik Trials is done (gates.ts CURATED_TRANSPORTS: its own sail proc, areas/area_miscellania/scripts/misc_sailor.rs2:13, which the sail scripts don't give).
